title: CS A: Escape the Matrix
description:
Ace the AP Computer Science A 2026 exam with our focused, all-digital prep course. Learn at your own pace with on-demand video lessons and crush the test with hundreds of AP-style practice questions.

This course provides everything you need to confidently score a 5:

✓ We cut the fluff and focus specifically on the 2026 College Board Course Framework, so you only study what's on the exam.
✓ Intensive practice on every type of question from Unit 1 to Unit 4, with detailed video explanations for every answer.
✓ Learn problem-solving strategies for the Free Response Questions, with access to unique practice questions, full-length practice exams, and reusable code snippets to save you time.
✓ Downloadable study guides, quick-reference sheets, and vocabulary lists for last-minute review.

The course is strategically organized into 5 core content blocks, culminating in our famous week-long "AP Crush Week" cram session right before the exam to lock in your knowledge.

💸 Buy any 2 courses and get 10% off instantly at checkout!

Course Structure block:
 - 10+ hours of theory
 - 20+ hours of practice
 - 4 Units
 - 53 Lessons + Unit Reviews
